outcome: Neonatal complications (transfer to intensive care, respiratory distress)
cohort: Singleton pregnancies complicated by preterm premature rupture of membranes and induced between 34 and 37 weeks
finding: Compared to locally applied prostaglandins, balloon catheter induction for preterm premature rupture of membranes between 34 and 37 weeks gestation is not associated with an increase in cesarean section rates.
